faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CMO Prayagraj MBBS MO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications for the CMO Prayagraj MBBS MO Recruitment 2026 is 21st September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the MBBS MO posts in CMO Prayagraj?
faq.answer: There are a total of 25 vacancies available for the MBBS MO posts in the Chief Medical Office Prayagraj recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the MBBS MO posts?
faq.answer: The primary educational qualification required for most of the MBBS MO posts is an MBBS degree registered with the MCI/U.P. Some specific posts may have additional preferences like experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MBBS MO posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the MBBS MO posts in this recruitment is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the MBBS MO positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the MBBS MO positions ranges from Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 per month, with some positions offering additional allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the CMO Prayagraj MBBS MO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the MBBS MO posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the MBBS MO posts will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. When are the walk-in interview dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview dates for the CMO Prayagraj MBBS MO Recruitment 2026 are scheduled for 28th September 2026 and 29th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the CMO Prayagraj MBBS MO Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Chief Medical Office Prayagraj, which is http://prayagraj.nic.in.
